Hello Sarah. Reviewing my emails I do not see a confirmation email... which

using PayPal on September the 18th.

Hi Ryan,

Thanks, that was enough for me to find it. Your order is Shop····, placed on September 18 and paid through PayPal. It's for a Magic M. 40T and the free Diagnostics + 3-Month RMA, going to (address hidden). It's under this email address, so the confirmation went here. I'm sorry about the wait. Your miner was due to ship by October 31 and that date slipped. All 300 units in this production run are now on their way to our warehouses, and your order ships by November 30. We'll email you the tracking number as soon as it leaves. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

We also sent you updates on November 3 and November 8. If those didn't reach your inbox either, please add (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so the tracking email arrives.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
